summary: Noise gate with an open threshold and a lower close threshold (hysteresis), attack, hold and release, peak or RMS detection, a closed-gate floor (Range), lookahead and a sidechain input: it shuts quiet passages and lets the loud ones through.
use_for: Noise gate with hysteresis, hold and peak or RMS detection.
quirks: The code, not its README, is right about Threshold: 0.5 dB steps from -60 to 0 dBFS (the README says 1 dB steps and -80).
The gate closes Hysteresis dB under Threshold, holds for Hold, then closes over Release.
Lookahead delays the output by the lookahead time (up to 25 ms); at 0 the gate reacts to a transient only as it arrives.
It is a hard gate: a closed gate sits at Range (0 is -90 dB, almost shut; 90 is no reduction).

parameters.name: Threshold
parameters.description: Gate open threshold in dBFS (−60.0 to 0.0, 0.5 dB steps)
parameters.how: Sets the level, from -60 to 0 dB in 0.5 dB steps, at which the gate opens.
parameters.sound: Higher thresholds let only the loud parts through; lower ones keep quieter material.

parameters.name: Hysteresis
parameters.description: Gap between open and close thresholds (dB). Higher = less chatter. The gate closes this far under the threshold
parameters.how: Makes the gate close this far below the opening level, from 0 to 20 dB.
parameters.sound: More hysteresis stops the gate from chattering on signals that hover near the threshold.

parameters.name: Attack ms
parameters.description: Time for gate to open fully (0 = instant, max 500 ms)
parameters.how: Sets how long the gate takes to open fully, from 0 to 500 ms.
parameters.sound: Short attacks keep the start of a hit sharp; long ones fade the sound in.

parameters.name: Hold ms
parameters.description: How long the gate stays open after signal drops below close threshold
parameters.how: Keeps the gate open for 0 to 2000 ms after the signal falls below the closing level.
parameters.sound: Longer holds stop the gate from cutting the ends of notes between close hits.

parameters.name: Release ms
parameters.description: Time for gate to close fully (1–2000 ms)
parameters.how: Sets how long the gate takes to close, from 1 to 2000 ms.
parameters.sound: Short releases chop tails; long ones fade them away.

parameters.name: Range dB
parameters.description: Closed-gate floor (0 = mute / −90 dBFS … 90 = no attenuation). The closed gate's gain: −90 dB nearly shut, 0 dB no gating
parameters.how: Sets how far the closed gate turns the signal down: 0 is nearly silent (-90 dB), 90 is no reduction.
parameters.sound: Low settings shut the sound completely; high settings only dip the level between hits.

parameters.name: Detection
parameters.description: Peak: fast transient response. RMS: smoother for sustained sources.
parameters.how: Chooses whether the gate listens to peaks or to the average level (RMS).
parameters.sound: Peak reacts to every transient; RMS is smoother on sustained sounds.

parameters.name: Lookahead ms
parameters.description: Pre-delay so gate opens before the transient arrives (0–25 ms)
parameters.how: Delays the audio by 0 to 25 ms so the gate can open before a transient arrives.
parameters.sound: The attack of a hit is never clipped; the output is that much later.

parameters.name: Bypass
parameters.sound: Lets you hear the sound without the gate.
